tools.name: find_cheaper
tools.description: Given an Airbnb listing URL and trip dates, finds the same home bookable somewhere else (on HomeShared, where guests pay no service fee, or on a host's own booking site) and returns each match with its all-in total including fees and taxes, how confident the match is, a link, and when the price was

tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Searches vacation rentals that are free for the given dates in a place and returns homes with their all-in totals (fees and taxes included), cheapest first, with links and offer_ids for get_quote. For trips without a specific listing in mind.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Gets a fresh, itemized all-in price and availability for one offer_id (from find_cheaper or search_stays) for specific dates and guests. Returns a quote_id that book needs; it stays valid for 15 minutes.

tools.name: book
tools.description: Checks a quote_id is still available and returns a checkout_url for the traveler to open. The traveler signs in, reviews the price, house rules and cancellation policy, and pays there; this tool reserves nothing and charges nothing by itself.
